title: Implement low-dispatch shared spatial build primitives
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Implement and benchmark the shared sort/scan/compaction/BVH-building primitives selected by F8-05 without forcing the current sixteen three-dispatch radix rounds into every consumer. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Compare justified algorithm choices on fixed dense, sparse, empty and duplicate-key inputs; record dispatch/workgroup counts, scratch bytes and timing rather than assuming fewer launches are faster.
Check key/identity stability, bounds, overflow and brute-force candidate correctness; work should scale with live elements rather than reserved capacity where practical.
Use shared Slang with portable subgroup/workgroup assumptions and reflection/binding compile checks for all backends; no vendor-specific physical equations.
Retain independent primitive oracles and explicit empty/small/large-capacity budget tests; no hot-path allocation or mandatory host count readback.
